name: Pictorix Image Report for Elementor (گزارش تصویری)
author: behrooz1986

sections.description:
Pictorix Image Report for Elementor is a specialized, lightweight, and modern Elementor widget developed by Meysam Behrouz. It allows publishers, journalists, and agencies to showcase photo stories, investigative reports, featured articles, and cultural galleries in responsive Bento-style and editorial magazine layouts.

Key Features in Version 2.4.0

  • Card Title HTML Tag Selection: Choose custom heading tags (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, div, span, p) independently for the hero card and small cards without breaking styles or typography.
  • Automatic Column Height Equalization: Equalizes the hero card height with the auxiliary small cards column across responsive desktop and tablet breakpoints.
  • Advanced Taxonomy Filtering (AND / OR): Full tax_query relation support combining categories and tags seamlessly.
  • Independent Card Background Customization: Fully configurable background colors for hero card and secondary cards via the Elementor style panel.
  • Date Placement & Typography Controls: Choose date placement (above title, below title, card bottom) and customize font size, color, and typography independently for big and small cards.
  • Elementor Dynamic Tags & Custom Fields: Native integration with Dynamic Tags across text fields and seamless WordPress post meta / ACF fallback.
  • 100% WordPress.org Plugin Repository Standards: Compliant with official Plugin Check tool, translators placeholders annotations, Tested up to 7.1, and POSIX standard zip archives.
  • 6 Distinct Visual Styles: Bento Classic, Editorial Magazine, Cinematic Overlay, Modern Minimal, Horizontal Stream, and Mosaic Grid.
  • Smart Interactive Card Sync: Hovering over any secondary card instantaneously updates the hero card preview smoothly.
  • Independent Post Link Navigation: Clicking cards opens respective post links directly in new tabs with target=”_blank” rel=”noopener noreferrer”.
  • Advanced WordPress Query System: Filter posts by categories, tags, taxonomy logic (AND/OR), custom post IDs, and custom ordering.
  • Seamless ACF Integration: Custom image fields, custom titles, date picker, and external URLs with fallback to core WordPress posts.
  • Native Solar Hijri (Jalali / Shamsi) Date: Built-in standalone Pictorix_IR_JDate converter with Persian numerals.
  • Versatile Dots Navigation: 8 placement presets with ARIA accessibility labels and keyboard focus.
  • Dedicated Archive Button: 4 ready design presets (Solid, Outlined, Arrow text, and Pill icon).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pictorix-image-report.zip file via WordPress Admin under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page with Elementor.
  4. Search for the “Pictorix Image Report” widget in the Elementor panel.
  5. Drag and drop the widget into your section and customize your query and style settings.
sections.faq:
Does this widget require Elementor Pro?

No, it works seamlessly with both the free version of Elementor and Elementor Pro.

Does it break if Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) is not installed?

No, the widget safely verifies ACF presence and gracefully falls back to default WordPress post thumbnails, titles, and dates.

How do I enable Shamsi (Jalali) dates?

In the widget content settings under the taxonomy and date section, the calendar type is set to Jalali by default with Persian numerals enabled.

Can I select custom HTML heading tags for SEO?

Yes, in the Card Style settings, you can independently pick H1 through H6 for both the main card and the auxiliary cards.
sections.changelog:
2.4.0

  • Official WordPress.org automated Plugin Check 100% compliance release.
  • Renamed plugin header to “Pictorix Image Report for Elementor (گزارش تصویری)” synchronized between readme.txt and main file.
  • Added “behrooz1986” and “meysambehrooz” to Contributors list.
  • Standardized Text Domain as “pictorix-image-report” strictly matching official WordPress.org approved slug across all files and translation calls.
  • Removed “Tested up to:” from main PHP plugin header (belongs strictly in readme.txt).
  • Kept “Tested up to: 7.1” in readme.txt for WordPress.org automated checker compliance.
  • Implemented full taxonomy relation (tax_relation: AND / OR) in WP_Query tax_query array for combined categories and tags.
  • Refactored code prefixes and naming standards with 4+ letter prefix PICTORIX_IR_*: Pictorix_IR_Plugin, Pictorix_IR_Widget, Pictorix_IR_JDate.
  • Added current_user_can(‘activate_plugins’) capability checks to all administrative notices.
  • Standardized packaging as pictorix-image-report.zip with pictorix-image-report/ root directory and pictorix-image-report.php main file.

2.3.2

  • Resolved Plugin Check warnings:
    • Synchronized plugin name in readme.txt with main PHP header.
    • Limited tags to 5 approved keywords (elementor, bento, report, gallery, jalali).
    • Sanitized post exclusion with array_filter and added phpcs compliance annotations.

2.3.1

  • Clean production release for WordPress.org repository submission.
  • Added independent HTML heading tag selection (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, div, span, p) for big card and small cards.
  • Added automatic column height equalization matching the big card to the small cards column across responsive breakpoints.
  • Added flexible date position controls (above title, below title, card bottom) for big and small cards.
  • Added dedicated date styling controls: independent font size, text color, and typography.
  • Added independent card background color controls in Elementor style panel.
  • Added native Elementor Dynamic Tags support across text, date, and URL controls.

2.2.0

  • Added 6 distinct style presets: Bento Classic, Editorial Magazine, Cinematic Overlay, Modern Minimal, Horizontal Stream, and Mosaic Grid.
  • Implemented smart hover-sync between small preview cards and the main hero card.
  • Added independent post link navigation opening in a new tab without slider conflicts.
  • Added 8 independent positioning presets for Dots Navigation with keyboard accessibility.
  • Integrated standalone Jalali date converter RSB_JDate with Persian numerals support.
  • Enhanced WP_Query engine with multi-category and multi-tag filtering with AND/OR logic.
  • Added safe ACF integration with fallback to standard post metadata.

2.1.0

  • Initial base release with core Bento grid layout.
